lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Why do so many nasty people

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: hide behind their online screen names

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: and hurl insults with such impunity?
Did something happen?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: My character is a tank in this game I'm playing.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: But nearly every player I meet

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: just says that I stink at it

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: and should quit playing.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: They even drag my parents into it!
That's too much.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I know, right?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: One time, another player got carried away.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: He somehow separated from the rest of us and died.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Yet, he blamed me for not doing my job!

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: He cursed me out and eventually rage quit.
Why don't you switch classes?
Ever thought about switching to a healer?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Do I have to?

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I mean it's not my responsibility to keep players alive when they get carried away.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Being a healer is stressful too.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: People are always on your case if the HPS is too low.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: There are definitely some good players in the game,

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: but it's all gotten so toxic that fewer people want to be a tank or healer.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Especially when all you experience is getting blamed for everything.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Oh, it's time for the next raid!

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Thanks for letting me blow off some steam.
No worries, hope the raid goes well.
